turn it into a dagitty object
```{r}
dag_object <- dagitty(dag_code)
```

turn the dag into a tibble
```{r}
tidy_dag_tibble <- tidy_dagitty(dag_object)

tidy_dag_tibble
```

next we want to extract the pairs of relationships which we have to plot for
```{r}
tidy_dag_tibble |> 
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(name, to) -> correlation_plot_combinations

# iterate over each combination
for(i in 1:nrow(correlation_plot_combinations)) {
  ancestor <- correlation_plot_combinations[i, "name"]
  descendant <- correlation_plot_combinations[i, "to"]
  
  ggplot(aes(x = ancestory, y = descendants)) +
  geom_point()
}
```
